# BharatBench

> Upload an Android APK; BharatBench scans it, runs it on a real Android 12 phone (redroid) under constrained conditions, ranks findings by estimated user impact, and explains them by voice. Runtime is skipped, never simulated, when the device lab is unreachable.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): reviewer map, repo map, where-is-X table, 5-minute offline verification
- [README.md](README.md): overview, architecture, fidelity table, deployment, status
- [docs/EVALUATION.md](docs/EVALUATION.md): each claim -> file:line -> test -> how to verify

## Specs and contracts
- [contracts/README.md](contracts/README.md): frozen REST, WebSocket, harness and agent-tool contracts
- [contracts/v2-voice-and-users.md](contracts/v2-voice-and-users.md): realtime voice protocol, users, conversations
- [features/README.md](features/README.md): index of features f01-f23 with specs
- [docs/FEATURE_MAP.md](docs/FEATURE_MAP.md): feature -> code -> tests -> status

## Reference
- [docs/PROMPTS.md](docs/PROMPTS.md): every LLM prompt, model, token limit, guardrails
- [docs/CONFIG.md](docs/CONFIG.md): environment variables, defaults, LLM_MODEL vs SARVAM_CHAT_MODEL
- [docs/TESTING.md](docs/TESTING.md): test suites, counts, commands, what is not tested
- [docs/METRICS.md](docs/METRICS.md): test counts and the few measured numbers (everything else not measured)
- [docs/LIMITATIONS.md](docs/LIMITATIONS.md): what is not simulated, not built, or unverified
- [docs/SETUP.md](docs/SETUP.md): host and Vercel setup

- [harness/harness/jobs.py](harness/harness/jobs.py): device job runner

- [harness/harness/security.py](harness/harness/security.py): dynamic security checks
